item.text: {"tool":"run_experiment","argument":"{\"mode\":\"improve\",\"parent\":\"exp-d6d6755b413e\",\"approach\":\"Repair the documented Java/native-library startup failure with a bounded single-image Audiveris preflight before rerunning the existing integration pipeline.\",\"objective\":\"Inspect inherited recognition-command diagnostics and capture the exact startup exception. If that succeeds, process all seven pilot images and independently parse each complete generated kern file, repairing serialization only where an actual parser diagnostic identifies a defect.
